jobs.description:
Are you passionate about renewable energy and eager to work at the forefront of the global energy transition? PEAK Wind is seeking an AI Engineer to help shape our AI roadmap and to build and orchestrate the agents our colleagues and clients will use every day. At PEAK Wind, AI is moving from prototypes into production, and renewable energy operations produce exactly the kind of complex, high-volume data where AI can deliver significant value.

Introducing the Data & Intelligence Team

You will become part of our Data & Intelligence (D&I) team, where we work within PEAK Wind’s asset management service offering and manage full value chain data management for our clients. We support renewable energy assets worldwide through data management, reporting solutions, analytics, and AI capabilities, helping deliver data-driven solutions that support our clients and renewable energy projects. Our team consists of highly motivated professionals who bring diverse backgrounds and a strong commitment to excellence. We support one another, share knowledge, and celebrate both individual and collective achievements.

You will report to the Head of Data & Intelligence and work day-to-day with our small team of engineers who have been building internal AI products at PEAK Wind for several years. You will work closely with colleagues across different areas, bringing your perspective to a collaborative and purposeful team environment.

How You Will Make an Impact

As an AI Engineer, you will take AI solutions from idea to production and keep them there. You will co-own our AI roadmap: helping decide which agents we build, in what order, and what “working” means for each of them. Then you will build them.

Our agent portfolio serves two audiences. Internally, our agents give colleagues across PEAK Wind a well-governed way to work with company knowledge, generate reports, and analyse wind farm performance. Other internal agents help our own engineers specify and build new features faster. Externally, we provide agent-driven capabilities in our client-facing products.

On smaller initiatives you may be the engineer primarily responsible for taking the solution from first conversation to deployment. On larger initiatives, you will work closely with Product Owners, data engineers, and domain experts in asset management. Either way, the distance from an idea to something running is deliberately short. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Co-develop and maintain the PEAK Wind AI roadmap with the AI team, turning business needs into scoped, sequenced deliverables

• Design, build, and deploy agentic systems for internal colleagues, from reporting and wind farm analysis to engineering-productivity agents

• Design, build, and deploy AI-driven features and agents in our client-facing products, working with SCADA, operations, and asset management data

• Orchestrate multi-agent workflows: tool use, memory, retrieval over company and client data, and integration with our platform through APIs

• Build the evaluation systems that tell us whether an agent works, before and after it reaches production

• Own the data and infrastructure work behind your own agents on the cloud.

• Implement responsible-AI practices for operational energy data: access control, data isolation between clients, logging, and guardrails

• Ship early and iterate put prototypes in users’ hands fast and feed what you learn back into the roadmap

• Collaborate with Product Owners and stakeholders to understand what they need, and push back when AI is not the right tool

• Document what you build so others can maintain, extend, and trust it

What Will Make You Successful in This Role

At PEAK Wind, we know success comes in many forms. What matters most is your mindset, curiosity, and drive to make an impact. The following qualities and experiences will help you succeed in this role:

• A degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or similar, or an equivalent track record of shipping software

• Hands-on experience in software development, ML, data engineering, or AI Engineering, including AI applications you have helped take into production

• Strong Python and/or TypeScript, and hands-on experience with at least one agent framework

• Experience building or extending evals for LLM and agent behaviour, or an interest in developing deeper expertise in this area

• Experience building in cloud environments, preferably Microsoft Azure; familiarity with PostgreSQL, APIs, and modern web stacks is an advantage

• You code with AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor as a matter of course

• Professional experience in the energy industry or another complex technical environment; renewable energy or SCADA experience is an advantage but not required

• Clear and effective communication skills in English, both spoken and written, with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike

• A go-doer mentality: you would rather ship something real this week and improve it next week than perfect it in a document

• A structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to take initiative, including owning a product from idea to delivery

• The ability to stay calm and constructive in a high-paced environment

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive in an international, cross-functional team

This role is designed for an engineer who has already gained some hands-on experience building AI solutions and is now looking to deepen that expertise in a highly practical, production-focused environment and enjoys building and learning.

Why Join PEAK Wind

• A real mandate to build with AI: an existing roadmap, internal users who want what you build, and clients ready to adopt it

• An international, inclusive, and diverse workplace where differences are valued

• The opportunity to work on leading renewable energy projects alongside experienced industry professionals

• Flexible working arrangements that support both your career and personal life

• A flat organisational structure where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter

• A strong focus on your learning, development, and professional growth

• A culture that values commitment, meaningful contributions, and having fun

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Fair Hiring

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace drives innovation, creativity, and stronger results. At PEAK Wind, we are committed to fair and transparent hiring processes, welcoming candidates from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our hiring decisions focus on what each person brings to the role and our team, and we are committed to ensuring transparent salary structures, with pay decisions based on clear, objective, and gender‑neutral criteria. Salary information, including the relevant salary band, will be shared with candidates when they are invited to a first interview.

How to Apply

We look forward to receiving your application. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been found. Please apply directly through our website. If you have any questions or would like to know more about the position, please contact People & Development at recruitment@peak-wind.com.

About PEAK Wind

PEAK Wind is an independent renewable energy specialist in commercial, financial, and technical operations, delivering advisory, intelligence, and asset management services to investors and developers around the world. From onshore and offshore wind generation to Power-to-X, we work across the entire energy lifecycle to optimise operations and maintenance, enhance asset performance, and provide a holistic view of renewable infrastructure portfolios.

Our values - Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity - are reflected in everything we do, from how we support our clients to how we collaborate as a team. At PEAK Wind, you will be able to apply your professional skills in a dynamic environment and experience a meaningful responsibility and involvement.

_Do you want to build production AI systems that change how the world’s largest dedicated fund manager within greenfield renewable energy deploys capital? If so, CIP Fund Solutions (CIP FS) is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to join our Digital & AI team in Copenhagen, Denmark.

**Team

**As Forward Deployed Engineer, you will join the Digital & AI team in CIP Fund Solutions, reporting to the Investment Lifecycle Lead. You will be part of a new delivery unit, developing and rolling out digital and AI solutions that bring efficiency to CIP’s investment teams, and you will set the unit’s technical direction.

**Role

**As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you work alongside the investment teams who use your systems, learn the documents and decisions they handle, and turn that knowledge into production software.

You will design, build and run the AI systems that support CIP’s investment lifecycle, working with data rooms, contracts, financial models and investment committee materials, and you will set the engineering standards that let CIP scale AI across teams.

**Responsibilities will consist of, but are not limited to:

**

• Design, build and run production AI systems for the investment lifecycle, owning integrations, reliability and monitoring.

• Build retrieval, document-processing and agent-based workflows over data rooms, contracts, due diligence reports and financial models.

• Define and run evaluations that test accuracy and reliability against CIP-specific benchmarks.

• Build in access control, data segregation between funds and audit trails from day one.

• Integrate with CIP’s Microsoft 365 and data platforms, working with IT and Security to run solutions as supported services.

• Set engineering standards and reusable components and help build the engineering team as the unit grows.

**You

**You hold a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, and bring 5-8 years of software engineering experience, including at least two years building LLM-powered systems in production. You write production code in Python plus TypeScript or C#, and have hands-on experience with retrieval-augmented generation, tool use and agents, structured extraction and model evaluation.

You also bring cloud engineering experience on Azure or a comparable platform, and a solid grasp of security and data governance in sensitive data environments.

Experience in financial services, energy or another regulated industry is a strong advantage.

**We look for the following in a candidate:

**

• Ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.

• Enjoy working face-to-face with users and turning their feedback into working software.

• Calm and decisive when delivery is urgent and requirements are unclear.

• High standards and ownership, from prototype through to production.

• Excellent written and verbal English. Danish is not a requirement.

**Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

jobs.occupation: Department Manager for Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I) at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
Department Manager for Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I) at Novo Nordisk Engineering

If you’re energised by electrical and instrumentation engineering and you thrive on combining people leadership with project execution, we’d love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for a Department Manager to join one of our Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I) departments. As part of our E&I organisation, you will divide your time between project execution and department management, ensuring both successful project delivery and the continued development of your team.

Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I) plays a key role in designing and delivering safe, reliable, and efficient pharmaceutical production facilities. Our work connects the physical production process with the systems that monitor, control, and safeguard it throughout the entire engineering lifecycle, from conceptual and detailed design to procurement, construction support, testing, commissioning, and qualification.

Your contribution will be important in developing people, strengthening technical excellence, and supporting the continued growth of our E&I capabilities as demand for complex pharmaceutical engineering solutions increases.

How you might spend your days

As a Department Manager, you’ll be:

• Leading and developing a team of approximately 11 employees and consultants

• Contributing to projects while providing technical and managerial leadership

• Managing resource allocation across projects and portfolios

• Driving employee, discipline, and competency development together with senior specialists

• Strengthening collaboration with colleagues in Denmark and Bangalore, India

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Skilled at bringing people together around a common purpose

• Result-oriented with a structured and proactive approach to leadership

• Focused on employee growth, engagement, and development

• Able to build strong professional relationships with customers and stakeholders

• Agile and comfortable prioritising in a dynamic project environment

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• You have at least 5 years of leadership experience

• You hold a BSc or MSc within Electrical Engineering, Automation or a related discipline

• You are fluent in written and spoken Danish and English

• You have knowledge of GMP and GEP requirements

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 19th November 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Director Jannick Kartman at +45 3075 5575.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

jobs.occupation: Senior Director, Alliance Management and Strategic Partnerships
jobs.description:
Does it excite you to work with partners to bring new medicines to the market and to patients, and do you have experience with taking partnerships from early science through to launch? If this sounds like you, and you are ready to take on a broad area of responsibilities, then you could be our new colleague.

Your new position

This Senior Director position reports to the SVP for Alliance Management, within a growing area of Commercial. The ambition is to evolve the mandate from ensuring partnerships are well governed and deliver against contractual obligations to maximizing the strategic, scientific and commercial value of our external partnerships across the asset lifecycle: from early science through development, regulatory approval, launch and lifecycle management. As we grow, the position offers the opportunity to build a "partner-to-market" value proposition for the entire organization and to shape the area that delivers it.

We offer exciting responsibilities:

• Shape and drive the partner-to-market agenda, keeping the route to market in focus and contributing to the strategy, operating model and growth of the area

• Lead strategic partnership assessments, from partner identification and deal thesis development to close collaboration with Business Development and the identification of portfolio and capability gaps that partnerships can address

• Maximize the value of partnered assets through strong alliance governance, timely milestone delivery and proactive risk management across the partnership portfolio

• Drive cross-functional alignment between Zealand teams and partners, and resolve escalations and conflicts constructively and swiftly

• Prepare partnerships for commercial success through launch readiness, market access collaborations and co-commercialization models

• Unlock lifecycle expansion opportunities with partners, including new indications that extend the value of Zealand assets

Your profile

You are motivated by the path from molecules to market, and by combining Zealand's strengths with those of our partners to reach patients faster and further. Alliance management experience is a strength, and you have a genuine motivation to drive partnership progress with the patient always in view. You are a strategic and commercially minded partner who builds trust easily, influences without relying on formal authority, and is energized by building something new in a growing organization. Curiosity, resilience and a bold, collaborative approach come naturally to you.

• Minimum 10 years of experience in biopharma or big pharma, within partnering, business development, alliance management, commercial or development roles

• Deep understanding of drug development and commercialization, demonstrated through hands-on experience from regulatory approval, launch readiness, market access or co-commercialization, and the ability to connect early scientific decisions to commercial outcomes

• Strong strategic and commercial acumen, including deal structures, partnership economics and deal thesis development, with the ability to assess where a partnership creates the most value for patients and for Zealand across the asset lifecycle

• Solid understanding of US market dynamics, including pricing, payer and market access considerations that shape partnered commercial strategies

• Solid understanding and experience working with Chinese market is an advantage

• Ability to challenge early science and clinical development programs with the end product in mind, ideally with experience within obesity and metabolic health

Your new team

Alliance Management reports to the Executive Vice President for Commercial and works at the interface between our partners and our internal functions across research, development, regulatory, commercial and business development

Let's bond and be bold

We have a unique culture, characterized by excellent teamwork and strong engagement across the organization. And we want you to help us strengthen this culture.

Making bonds is at the core of everything we do. From discovering and developing the best new peptide drugs for patients, to engaging with our partners or connecting with each other. We bond through curiosity and playfulness as a team, allowing ourselves to challenge common thinking and drive future innovation. Join us and let's bond and be bold.

Interested in bonding with us? Then please apply no later than 12 November 2026 or as soon as possible. The applications will be reviewed as they come in. While a cover letter is not required, please include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and welcome applications from all job applicants.

About Zealand Pharma A/S

Zealand Pharma A/S (Nasdaq: ZEAL) is a biotechnology company focused on advancing medicines for obesity and metabolic health. Combining more than 25 years of peptide R&D expertise with a proprietary data platform that leverages advanced data-driven and AI/ML approaches, Zealand Pharma aims to lead a new era in obesity and metabolic health. To date, more than ten Zealand Pharma-invented drug candidates have entered clinical development, of which two products have reached the market and three candidates are in late-stage development. The Company has collaborations with global pharmaceutical and biotechnology partners for research, development, and commercialization. Founded in 1998, Zealand Pharma is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, with a U.S. presence in Boston, Massachusetts. Learn more at www.zealandpharma.com.

jobs.occupation: Associate Digital Product Director – Regulatory Data & AI
jobs.description:
Does it excite you to shape digital products and AI-enabled solutions that make regulatory data flow reliably across the enterprise and on to EMA and FDA, and do you have experience with Veeva Vault RIM? If this sounds like you, and you are ready to take on a broad area of responsibilities, then you could be our new colleague.

Your new position

As Associate Digital Product Director – Regulatory Data & AI, you will drive the evolution of our digital products, enterprise systems and data capabilities, with a primary focus on Regulatory Affairs and Medical Writing and opportunities across the wider organization. A key responsibility is the continued development of regulatory data capabilities in Veeva Vault RIM and other connected Vaults, ensuring that product hierarchies and master data are structured consistently and flow reliably across systems and to health authorities. You will act as business owner of regulatory data, working in close partnership with Digital, Data & Technology (DD&T’s) Data Analytics & AI Platforms team. As our pipeline advances towards late-stage submissions and our digital transformation accelerates, you will build the foundations for connected, data-driven and increasingly AI-enabled business processes that are built on trusted data and responsible AI practices.

We offer exciting responsibilities:

• 
Drive digital product strategy and roadmaps aligned with Zealand’s enterprise data and AI strategy, translating business needs into prioritized initiatives that deliver measurable value

• 
Own the product hierarchy and regulatory master data in Veeva Vault RIM as business data owner, ensuring clear stewardship, accuracy, completeness and consistency across the organization

• 
Connect business-critical regulatory data across Veeva RIM, eTMF and Safety Vaults and, together with DD&T, make it available to enterprise platforms and data lakes, in alignment with regulatory data standards (IDMP, SPOR, xEVMPD, eCTD v4.0), GxP and data integrity requirements for EMA and FDA

• 
Explore and assess generative AI, AI agents, intelligent automation and advanced analytics, and turn promising opportunities into practical solutions for Regulatory Affairs and Medical Writing, through governed AI delivery, together with DD&T and business teams

• 
Define and own regulatory data products, APIs, reporting and business intelligence solutions, built on the shared enterprise data platform with DD&T, that make information more accessible, actionable and reusable across functions

• 
Lead system evolution and cross-functional transformation initiatives, including those supporting Medical Writing, from evaluating new releases and capabilities to implementation, validation, change management and post-launch optimization

Your profile

You are a digitally minded product professional who combines business understanding, systems thinking and technological curiosity. You understand the importance of regulatory data and the processes it supports, and you look beyond individual systems to see opportunities across the wider digital ecosystem. You work independently, bring structure to complex initiatives and build trusted relationships across business and technology teams. You are comfortable owning data in the business and you are curious about how AI, automation and modern data platforms can transform the way we work, and you help colleagues build confidence in new ways of working.

• 
Extensive experience in digital product management, business systems or technology transformation, ideally within pharmaceutical, biotech or another regulated industry

• 
Solid understanding of Regulatory Affairs and the product development lifecycle, including CTAs/INDs, eCTD, submissions and lifecycle management

• 
Experience with complex business applications, data models, master data and cross-system integrations; hands-on experience with Veeva Vault RIM is important, and experience with eTMF or Safety Vaults is an advantage

• 
Ability to define product vision, prioritize competing needs and align business, IT, data and external partners around shared outcomes

• 
Familiarity with APIs, data pipelines, data lakes, business intelligence and tools such as Vault Loader, as well as data governance, data ownership and data product concepts, and an interest in generative AI and intelligent automation

• 
Proven ability to lead complex initiatives independently, including integrations, release management in GxP-validated environments, adoption and change management

Your new team

You will join Regulatory Operations (RegOps), part of Regulatory Affairs & Medical Writing. RegOps is a team of four and the backbone of our regulatory submissions and systems, responsible for Veeva Vault RIM, submission publishing and the regulatory data that supports our pipeline. The team also supports digital and process initiatives within Medical Writing. You will work closely with Regulatory Affairs, Medical Writing, Clinical, Safety, DD&T, the Data Analytics & AI Platforms team and external partners.

Let's bond and be bold

We have a unique culture, characterized by excellent teamwork and strong engagement across the organization. And we want you to help us strengthen this culture.

Making bonds is at the core of everything we do. From discovering and developing the best new peptide drugs for patients, to engaging with our partners or connecting with each other. We bond through curiosity and playfulness as a team, allowing ourselves to challenge common thinking and drive future innovation. Join us and let's bond and be bold.

Interested in bonding with us? Then please apply no later than November 11, 2026, or as soon as possible. The applications will be reviewed as they come in. While a cover letter is not required, please include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

For further information, please contact Head of Regulatory Operations Kristian Kiilerich: kkiilerich@zealandpharma.com.

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and welcome applications from all job applicants.

About Zealand Pharma A/S

Zealand Pharma A/S (Nasdaq: ZEAL) is a biotechnology company focused on advancing medicines for obesity and metabolic health. Combining more than 25 years of peptide R&D expertise with a proprietary data platform that leverages advanced data-driven and AI/ML approaches, Zealand Pharma aims to lead a new era in obesity and metabolic health. To date, more than ten Zealand Pharma-invented drug candidates have entered clinical development, of which two products have reached the market and three candidates are in late-stage development. The Company has collaborations with global pharmaceutical and biotechnology partners for research, development, and commercialization. Founded in 1998, Zealand Pharma is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, with a U.S. presence in Boston, Massachusetts. Learn more at www.zealandpharma.com.

**

**Who We Are Looking For

You’re curious about how collaboration services can evolve, including through responsible use of automation and AI.

**Practical information

**

• GlobalConnect’s standard setup is at least 3 days per week in the office.

• GlobalConnect does not offer relocation packages or work visa sponsorship for this role.

In this role, you’ll have the scope to shape a broad, business-critical portfolio and help make everyday collaboration more secure, reliable and effective for employees.

No need for a personal letter – just send us your CV or LinkedIn profile.

Join us and be part of the transformation in the most exciting company within critical digital infrastructure in Northern Europe! Apply today!

**About Us

**GlobalConnect is one of the leading connectivity providers in Northern Europe. We’re 2000 passionate and talented individuals who want to make a difference, turning our customers’ visions into reality through connectivity. Our goal is to create the best possible conditions for engaged employees, a place where you can develop and grow, and create unforgettable memories and enjoyable experiences.

Do you enjoy creating structure in complex projects, bringing business and technology teams together, and turning transformation ambitions into measurable results?

At Sofigate, we combine transformation expertise with modern platforms, data and AI. We are now looking for an experienced Digital Project Manager to join our Copenhagen team and lead customer projects across digital transformation and enterprise technology.

Your role

As a Digital Project Manager, you will lead transformation initiatives from planning through implementation and adoption. Your projects may involve enterprise platforms such as ServiceNow, IT implementations, Process Transformation or AI-enabled solutions.

Working closely with business and technology stakeholders, you will create clarity, maintain momentum and ensure tangible business value—whether you lead an entire project or programme, a transformation workstream or the establishment of effective governance and delivery structures.

What you will do

• Lead digital transformation and enterprise technology projects from initiation to implementation

• Translate business objectives into clear plans, governance and measurable outcomes

• Build trusted relationships with customers and stakeholders across business and IT

• Coordinate multidisciplinary teams and create structure and momentum in complex environments

• Manage scope, timelines, risks, dependencies and decision-making

• Facilitate workshops and steering groups while supporting communication, change and adoption

• Use AI-supported tools to improve planning, reporting, analysis and project delivery

• Contribute to customer roadmaps and identify opportunities for continued business value

What you bring

We value mindset, experience and potential over a perfect checklist. You are proactive, pragmatic and comfortable taking ownership when not everything is defined from the outset.

We imagine that you:

• Have 3–5 years of experience leading digital transformation, technology or platform-related projects

• Understand how business processes, technology and organisational change come together in successful transformations

• Are confident working with stakeholders at different organizational levels across business and IT

• Bring a structured and solution-oriented approach to planning, governance, and delivery

• Are curious about AI, automation and how emerging technologies can create measurable business value

• Have an entrepreneurial mindset, work independently and communicate fluently in Danish and English

Experience with ServiceNow or IT operating-model transformation would be a strong advantage.

Consulting and organizational change management experience are also valuable.

Why Sofigate?

At Sofigate, your growth truly matters. You will join around 20 colleagues in our Copenhagen office in Østerbro, where we have an informal and supportive culture with the freedom to shape your own work and contribute to the growth of our Danish business. At the same time, you will be part of a Nordic community built on collaboration, trust and entrepreneurship.

You will work on meaningful transformation projects across industries, with opportunities to explore leading enterprise platforms and AI-enabled solutions. Through hands-on customer work, knowledge sharing and close collaboration with experienced colleagues across the Nordics, you will continue developing as a consultant and project leader.

We value wellbeing, flexibility, diversity and inclusion, and offer flexible and hybrid ways of working alongside a competitive salary and benefits package.

Our values are dare, care and grow: we challenge established ways of working, care about our customers and colleagues, and grow together.

Ready to lead change with us?

Tell us your story and why you would like to join Sofigate. Please submit your application and CV in English. We review applications continuously and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To be considered for the position, you must be legally permitted to live and work in Denmark.

If you have any questions, please contact Nevine Chorbaji, Talent Acquisition Partner, at nevine.chorbaji@sofigate.com.

**About Sofigate

**We are The Business Technology Company with the fastest time-to-value in the generative AI era. By combining transformation expertise with low/no-code platforms and generative AI, we help customers design and implement transformations and business-friendly solutions using platforms such as ServiceNow, Salesforce and SAP.

We founded the Business Technology Forum and developed the Business Technology Standard. Our community of more than 800 professionals works across Finland, Sweden, Denmark, Hungary and Poland, always ready to support our colleagues and customers.

We are more than 800 top notch professionals with diverse backgrounds, working with customers from all sectors and various industries. We are a people business, and we believe it’s our people’s competence that counts.

We want you to add your skills into the mix. At Sofigate, you will find plenty of collective know-how to draw on, along with opportunities to learn and grow

Our values Dare, Care and Grow are visible in our every day life - find out more about Sofigate and join us!

**The Impact You'll Make

**Do you enjoy turning complex technical data into insights that drive better products and smarter decisions? Are you passionate about combining data science with engineering and domain expertise to solve real-world challenges? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

As our Lead Engineer, Data Science, you’ll play a key role in transforming product, sensor and operational data into meaningful insights that support innovation, energy efficiency and data-driven decision-making across Danfoss Climate Solutions.

Working closely with business teams, engineers and data platform specialists, you’ll combine strong analytical capabilities with engineering and domain knowledge to identify high-value opportunities, shape AI and analytics use cases and help build a robust, AI-ready data foundation for future intelligent solutions.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Translate complex business and engineering challenges into analytical questions, data-driven models and actionable insights

• Analyze product, sensor, device and operational data to identify patterns, trends and opportunities for performance and energy optimization

• Apply engineering and domain knowledge to shape high-value data science and AI use cases, including feature definition, hypothesis development and validation strategies

• Collaborate with data engineers and platform teams to improve data quality, accessibility and usability across analytics and data products

• Contribute to semantic models and knowledge graph capabilities that capture relationships between sensors, devices, assets and their operational context

• Communicate insights and recommendations clearly to technical and business stakeholders, helping turn analytical findings into practical business actions

**What We're Looking For

**

• Strong foundation in thermodynamics and physics, with the ability to apply first-principles reasoning to heating and cooling systems and processes

• Experience in data science, applied analytics or similar roles within a technical, industrial or engineering environment

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in Python and SQL and the ability to translate engineering insight into data-driven models

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, data and business teams

• Experience with HVAC, refrigeration, heating/cooling, energy systems or industrial operational data is considered a strong advantage

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**Our Commitment to Transparency

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

jobs.description:
**Job Description

****Join us in building a new strategic integration capability

**Are you motivated by shaping new solutions from the ground up? Do you enjoy turning complex business ambitions into secure, scalable technology?

We are establishing a new team in the Customer & Sector Integration tribe to accelerate ERP-to-Bank. The initiative will enable corporate customers to securely share ERP data with Danske Bank, creating opportunities for automated financial processes, improved customer experiences and data-driven products and advisory. You will help determine how Danske Bank connects directly with ERP platforms and through ERP data aggregators, and how ERP data can be securely acquired, governed and made available to internal consumers.

As Solution Architect and IT Solution Owner, you will set the technical direction and lead the architecture of this new solution area. You will work closely with the Product Owner, engineers, internal stakeholders and external ERP ecosystem partners.

**You will

**

• Define and drive the solution architecture for ERP-to-Bank.

• Act as IT Solution Owner for the solutions established within the domain.

• Translate business needs into secure, scalable and maintainable designs.

• Shape integrations with ERP platforms and ERP data aggregators.

• Establish architectural principles, solution boundaries and technical roadmaps.

• Guide decisions related to APIs, data, security, identity and cloud technologies.

• Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, regulatory requirements and technology standards.

• Coordinate dependencies across business areas, tribes and external partners.

• Support engineers through technical guidance, sparring and architecture reviews.

The combined role brings responsibility for both technical direction and the lifecycle, governance and operational health of the solutions.

**About You

**

• At least five years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture or technical leadership.

• Current experience as a solution architect, technical lead or IT Solution Owner.

• Strong experience designing integration-heavy, business-critical solutions.

• Knowledge of API-based, event-driven and cloud-native architectures.

• Experience designing secure integrations with customers or external partners.

• The ability to communicate complex technical topics to both technical and business stakeholders.

• A collaborative and pragmatic approach to architecture and delivery.

Experience with banking, ERP platforms, accounting data, payments, cash management or third-party data providers would be an advantage.

**Why join?

**You will join a new team and help define the architecture, integration model and technology choices from the beginning. It is an opportunity to work at the intersection of banking, ERP ecosystems, data and modern integration technology, while turning a strategic ambition into a sustainable production capability.

The workplace can be in Lithuania or Denmark. If you are hired in Lithuania, the monthly salary range: from 5760 EUR to 8640 EUR gross (based on competencies relevant to the role).

Your title in job contract will be Software Architecture.

**Interested?

**Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Please include a short motivational letter with your CV. If you have questions about the position, contact Tribe Architect Kenneth Mejnert on mejn@danskebank.dk

We're looking for a senior AI engineer with hands-on experience in generative AI, API integrations, and advanced agent-based applications. The ideal candidate brings a mix of full-stack, AI, and cloud engineering experience.

**

_Do you want to shape how the world’s largest dedicated fund manager within greenfield renewable energy uses AI to deploy capital? If so, CIP Fund Solutions (CIP FS) is looking for a Product Manager to join our Digital & AI team in Copenhagen, Denmark.

**As Product Manager, you will join the Digital & AI team in CIP Fund Solutions, reporting to the Investment Lifecycle Lead. You will be part of a new delivery unit, developing and rolling out digital and AI solutions that will bring efficiency to CIP’s investment teams.

**Behind every investment decision at CIP sit data rooms, contracts, financial models and investment committee materials. As Product Manager, you will find where AI saves the investment teams the most time or improves their decisions and turn that into products they use every day. You will own the AI product roadmap for the investment lifecycle, from identifying use cases through delivery, adoption and measured impact.

**

• Own and prioritize the AI product roadmap for the investment lifecycle.

• Turn business problems into requirements, success metrics and acceptance criteria for engineering.

• Prototype and demo concepts with users before committing engineering capacity.

• Drive adoption and report impact in time saved, cycle time and usage.

**

• Clear, concise communication, with the ability to explain complex topics simply.

---

A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. Pandektes is building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world. Behind it is a backend that has to ingest, structure and search a huge database of legal information.

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help us making sure that the legislation and volume of data stays stable so we can scale our services so we can ingest larger volumes of data, more efficiently.

We have recently closed our Series A round and joining now means you will have a big impact how we grow in the future. This role is based in our Copenhagen HQ.

About Pandektes

Our mission is to rebuild legal research from the ground up. Lawyers still lose countless hours to fragmented sources, outdated systems, and databases that fight them at every turn. We're building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world to make that friction disappear.

We're a team of 45+ based in our Copenhagen HQ, Zurich, London, and Hamburg. We’re a small team with high trust and flat structure. We move fast, argue our positions, and ship. If your input is good, it gets implemented - often within hours, not sprints.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

The experience you’ll bring

You’ve built and operated backend systems that real customers depend on. You can work through questions about data, APIs, performance, and security, and explain the consequences of your decisions.

Experience integrating AI technologies like OpenAI and Pinecone into production systems to build innovative, data-driven solutions. Experience with vector databases, transformers, NLP and LLMs is a plus.

Our stack includes TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, Postgres, and Prisma. We also work with OpenAI and Turbopuffer. Experience with these tools is useful; we’re especially interested in what you’ve built with them and the decisions you made along the way.

What we value

“How fast can we ship this?” comes up a lot at Pandektes. So does “we should take our time with this one.”

Knowing which question to ask is a big part of being an engineer here.

Knowing when it’s good enough

We like getting things into customers’ hands quickly. That means making trade-offs, questioning scope, and accepting when something is good enough for now. There’s usually another approach to explore or another prompt to try. At some point, you have to ship.

We use AI throughout our development process. AI code reviews, feature flags, and remote coding agents running end-to-end tests help us move quickly with confidence. Deciding what to build, what to check, and when it’s ready still takes judgment.

We value people who can find a smaller version worth shipping, explain the trade-offs, and follow through once customers start using it.

Knowing when to slow down

Some decisions deserve more time. Getting them right makes everything that follows easier. Getting them wrong means paying for the same mistake repeatedly.

Our default is to move quickly, so slowing down takes discipline. Sometimes it means pushing back when the rest of us want to get something out. We value someone who can explain why the extra work matters, challenge an approach, and help us decide where to spend our time.

You’ll have room to make those calls here, and teammates who will question them. We expect you to do the same for us.

Make time to experiment

We enjoy trying things before we know whether they’ll work. A new tool, a different way to use an agent, an idea that might turn out to be useless. Finding out is part of the work.

Once a month, we get together to demo our setups, show what we’re experimenting with, and share what we’ve learned. Sometimes we invite people from outside the team to show us how they work. Those sessions have changed how we build software.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We try to watch this video once a month to keep this value top of mind.

What we offer

You’ll join at a point where there’s still a lot to shape. We offer competitive pay and equity so you can share in the success you help create.

We are usually office based but we all work from home time to time. You’ll have your own Pleo card for the tools and work expenses you need, plus 25 vacation days a year, public holidays, and paid parental leave when your family grows.

We also make time to get together away from our usual work. Our last team trip was to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you along for the next one.
